heroLead: Gentle 1:1 sessions of easy stretching, mobility, and posture work, kept within a comfortable, pain-free range and built around your body and how you feel each day. Practised alongside any care from your doctor.
empathyLabel: You don't have to do this alone
empathyText: Everyday aches wear you down. Yoga can be a gentle way to move more comfortably, easing stiffness within a pain-free range, alongside any care from your doctor.
helpsH2: How yoga can support pain relief.
helpsSubhead: Four gentle levers, working together, and the first one does most of the lifting.

levers.title: Gentle mobility
levers.body: Easy movement helps stiff areas feel looser and more comfortable.

levers.title: Better posture
levers.body: Simple posture work eases the strain that builds from sitting all day.

levers.title: Release everyday tension
levers.body: Slow stretches and breathing help tight muscles let go.

levers.title: Move with confidence
levers.body: Comfortable, repeatable movement you can use in daily life.

posesH2: The poses we focus on, and why.
posesSubhead: Grouped by what they do for the body. Your teacher draws from these, so they won't ask you to do all of them.

poseGroups.why: Gentle mobility for a stiff back, kept pain-free.

poses.desc: Soft spinal mobility that warms the back and eases stiffness, paced to you.
A light, supported backbend without strain. For sensitive backs we choose gentle arching or rounding, whichever eases your spine.
A gentle low-back release that helps the spine settle and soften.
A soft, restful stretch that lets the back and shoulders unwind.

poseGroups.note: For sensitive backs we avoid deep loaded forward folds and strong twists, and never push into pain. Please see your doctor first if pain is recent, severe, or comes with numbness or radiating pain.

poseGroups.why: Easing the tension from screens and sitting.

poses.desc: Slow, guided movements that help the neck feel freer and less tight.
A shoulder stretch that opens the upper back between the shoulder blades.
A gentle upper-back release that eases tension across the shoulders.

poseGroups.why: Loosening the hips that tighten from sitting.

poses.desc: A gentle hip stretch that releases tightness from long hours of sitting.
A gentle hip-flexor opener that frees up the front of the hips.
A gentle, supported lift that works the back of the body without strain.
Slow, even breathing that settles the nervous system and softens tension.
A still close to every session, letting everything you've done settle in.
Restorative rest that releases tension and helps muscles let go.

selectionNote: Your teacher won't hand you all of these. They'll choose the right few for your body, your level, and how you're feeling that day.
howH2: How we work with you to get there.
howSubhead: One teacher who knows your name and your goals, not a different face every week.

steps.title: We get to know you
steps.body: A relaxed first session: your areas of tension, your comfortable range, and anything your doctor has advised.

steps.title: A plan shaped to you

steps.title: Guided live 1:1s

faqs.q: Will yoga fix my back or neck pain?
faqs.a: It can help you move more comfortably, but it isn't a medical treatment. Please see your doctor for diagnosis, especially for any red-flag symptoms.

faqs.q: When should I see a doctor first?
faqs.a: If pain is recent and severe, follows an injury, or comes with numbness, tingling, weakness, or pain radiating down a limb.
No. We stay within a comfortable, pain-free range and never push into pain. The goal is easier movement, not deep stretching.

faqs.q: Do I need to be flexible?
faqs.a: Not at all. This is about comfortable everyday movement, and sessions begin exactly where your body is.

faqs.q: Can I do this if I have arthritis or a disc issue?
faqs.a: Often yes, gently and adapted. Please check with your doctor and tell your teacher so we can plan around it.

safetyTitle: Yoga supports your care, it doesn't replace it
safetyText: These sessions support your overall wellbeing and are practised alongside professional medical care. They are not a substitute for diagnosis, treatment, or medication. Please tell your teacher about any conditions or symptoms so they can adapt your session safely, and keep your doctor in the loop.
metaDescription: Gentle 1:1 yoga for everyday back, neck, and joint tension: easy stretching, mobility, and posture work kept within a comfortable, pain-free range. First session free.
